text:
melissa: Moving cross-country on Sunday, free to anyone who can pick up tomorrow: IKEA ALEX 6-drawer (white) — very good condition, minor scuffs, tabletop staples removed. Also a midcentury ceramic task lamp (works). Also have 2 SF Giants tickets for Saturday (sec 110). Pics: https://i.imgur.com/abcd1234.jpg

jon: Oooo pics please for the drawers — size? will it fit in a Prius?

melissa: Dimensions are 70cm x 40cm x 75cm. probably not a Prius unless you fold seats. Lamp is small. https://i.imgur.com/abcd1234_2.jpg

raj: I can take the lamp if someone else takes the drawers. DM me the pickup window.

kelsey: Interested in the tickets — are they free or paid? :baseball:

melissa: If someone takes the furniture set (drawers + lamp) I'll toss in the 2 tickets free. Otherwise $25 for the pair. Pickup window: Sat 11:00–14:00 in Potrero / 22nd St area.

ops-bot: :warning: Reminder: please avoid posting full personal addresses in public channels. Use DMs for exact pickup location.

melissa: thanks @ops-bot — sending address & gate code via DM.

jon: Can anyone help carry the drawers? They're heavier than they look.

sasha: I can bring my friend with a hatchback, can be there ~12:00. happy to help move.

melissa: @sasha you're a legend, thank you! :heart: If you can help move, I'll mark the drawers as spoken-for to the first person who confirms pickup + helps.

raj: DMed you about the lamp. If it's still free after drawers get claimed, I'll swing by.

kelsey: DMing about tickets. Thanks!!

melissa: Quick note: I'll prioritize full set takers (drawers + lamp + tickets). If that falls through, will split items. First come, first served — but I will update here once claimed.

jon: happy to be on standby if anything falls through. :thumbsup:

melissa: Update: drawers + lamp reserved to @sasha's crew (pickup 12:00). Tickets reserved to @kelsey. If anything changes I'll post here. Thanks everyone!

kelsey: Yay! thanks melissa :party_parrot:

raj: Thanks for the lamp offer anyway — appreciate it.

melissa: All set — closing thread. :sparkles:
